name: Paris Saint-Germain 2024-26 (Luis Enrique, post-Mbappé)
scopeNote: PSG under Luis Enrique from the first competitive match of 2024/25 (Le Havre 1-4 PSG, 2024-08-16; date and score from search summaries of several outlets, no mined page confirmed it) to the latest match verified on a mined page: Manchester City 2-4 PSG, Champions League league phase, 2026-10-14 (CulturePSG 2026-10-14). The PSG-Barcelona match of 2026-10-20 is only mentioned as upcoming; no result was found. 2023/24 (Luis Enrique's first season, with Mbappé) is NOT counted. Every source entry carries a 'season' field (2024/25, 2025/26, 2026/27) so the profile can be narrowed. Best documented: 2024/25 (Coaches' Voice final v Inter 5-0 on 2025-05-31, CulturePSG/Lefaucheux 4-2-4 and 3-2-2-3, El Buen Fútbol man-to-man press map, CulturePSG set-piece piece) and the 2025/26 Champions League final (Coaches' Voice, Arsenal 1-1, 4-3 on penalties, 2026-05-30; CulturePSG 3-1-2-2-2-0 piece). 2025/26 league season and 2026/27 (only 8 competitive matches or so) are thin: mostly press quotes. Style terms used by sources: 'jeu de position 2.0' (Lefaucheux), 4-2-4 against a high press, 3-2-2-3 ('3-box-3') against a low block, 3-1-2-2-2-0 in 2025/26, 'without a defined centre-forward' (Coaches' Voice), 'faux 9' (Soccerway FR). 'Juego posicional' in the sense of Barcelona-style tiki-taka is not what sources describe: rotations are fluid and pressing is player-to-player. Set pieces: 'zone mixte avec quatre joueurs libres' plus offside trap (CulturePSG 2024-09). Event dates for 2025-04, 2024-08/2024-09 etc. are partial where only month is known.
openQuestions: Total Football Analysis (2026 final) says PSG lined up in a 4-3-3 with Safonov in goal, Pacho/Marquinhos centre-backs; Coaches' Voice describes a back-three build with Hakimi high. Possibly both views of the same match; TFA also contains claims not confirmed elsewhere (28 kick-off long-ball presses in Ligue 1). Treat TFA details as tier B but unconfirmed.

The 3-1-2-2-2-0 label comes from a single author (Lefaucheux, CulturePSG/Sky Sport Suisse), v Liverpool in 2026 quarter-final first leg; Coaches' Voice 2026 final calls it a back three plus Vitinha pivot with 'attacking pairs'.

Man-marking in 2025/26 is documented only by Goal DE (opponents' man-orientation hurt PSG, Chelsea CWC final) and Lefaucheux (Gravenberch lost Kvaratskhelia); no source on PSG's own man-marking pressing in 2025/26 was mined.
Set pieces in 2025/26 and 2026/27: only the TFA kick-off press claim; no mined source on attacking/defending corners this period.
Latest verified match is 2026-10-14; PSG/Barça 2026-10-20 and later matches not verified.
Search summaries (not mined, unverified) mention Ferran Torres signing 2026 and Kvaratskhelia Champions League player of the season; only World Soccer Talk and Flashscore mined pages touch this.
Dembélé is called a 'false 9'/central forward by different sources: kept as 'without a defined centre-forward' per Coaches' Voice 2025.
